sheets.prompt:
Image 1 is a sticker of a little orange hermit crab character living in a striped spiral shell. Draw this exact hermit crab as a cut-out paper puppet: its separate body parts laid out on one sheet, the same drawing style, colours, texture, line and proportions as in image 1, every part at the size it has in image 1.

Draw each part on its own, spread out over the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, no part touching or overlapping another:
1. the empty shell: the striped pink-and-cream spiral shell alone, as in image 1, with nobody in it: its round opening on the right a dark, empty hollow.
2. the shell with the hermit crab hidden deep inside it: the same shell as in image 1, only the tips of the crab's two little claws showing in the dark opening.
3. the crab's body: the little round orange body and head, facing the viewer as in image 1, with a completely blank face — no eyes, no mouth — keep the rosy cheeks; without eyes, claws or legs; drawn whole, its top (normally under the shell's rim) a full rounded edge.
4. one claw: the claw on the left of image 1 with its short arm, its pincers closed, the arm's end rounded.
5. one walking leg: a little slim, curved, jointed orange leg with a pointed tip, its top end rounded.

Every part is drawn whole, including what is normally hidden behind another part, and each joint end (where it tucks under the body or another part) is a full, smooth, rounded edge. No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a little orange hermit crab character living in a striped spiral shell; image 2 shows the same hermit crab cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw the hermit crab's face pieces as separate stickers on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours and line as in image 1, every piece at the size it has on the hermit crab in image 1, so it fits the blank face in image 2.

Draw each piece on its own, spread out in tidy rows with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
1. one of the hermit crab's eyes as it is in image 1: only the round eye ball — the white eye with its big dark pupil and white sparkle, in its thin orange rim — the ball alone, with NO stalk or head below it, its bottom edge a full round curve like the rest of the ball. Every eye below is this same ball, alone.
2. the same ball with the eye wide open and surprised: the pupil smaller, the white bigger, with its sparkle.
3. the same ball with the eye gently closed in sleep: an orange lid shut over it, a soft downward-curving line with a few lashes.
4. the same ball with the eye closed in a happy smile: an orange lid, an upward-curving arc.
5. the same ball with the eye sad: looking down, its orange upper lid drooping, tilted towards the middle.
6. the same ball with the eye squeezed shut, crying: an orange lid shut tight in a creased, downward-curving line.
7. the mouth as it is in image 1: a small happy smile line.
8. the mouth wide open in a big happy laugh, the inside pink.
9. the mouth open in a small round 'o'.
10. the mouth in a small sad frown.
11. the mouth open in a wobbly crying wail, its corners turned down, the inside pink.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.

animations.description: the hermit crab hides inside its shell, then peeks out

pause.shows: only the spiral shell, the hermit crab hidden right inside it, the shell's opening dark

animations.description: the hermit crab scuttles along to the right on its little legs, carrying its shell, then stops.
the hermit crab tucks itself away in its shell, then peeks out with just its eyes, looking this way and that, and comes out smiling.

pause.shows: only the hermit crab's eyes peeking out of the dark opening of its shell

animations.description: the hermit crab wiggles, its shell wobbling from side to side on its back, and it giggles.
the hermit crab waves hello with one little claw.
the hermit crab looks one way, then the other, then back.
the hermit crab crouches and gives a happy hop, shell and all, landing with a little squash.
the hermit crab laughs and laughs, bouncing with giggles.
the hermit crab talks, its mouth moving, its head bobbing a little.
the hermit crab shivers and trembles, cold or scared, pulling in close to its shell.
the hermit crab cries, head down, its little body shaking with sobs.
the hermit crab gives a big yawn, snuggles back into its shell and falls asleep, then wakes up, blinks and smiles.

pause.shows: the hermit crab fast asleep, snuggled into its shell, eyes shut

animations.description: the hermit crab does a happy little dance, swaying its shell from side to side and waving its claws.
the hermit crab nods yes, twice.
